title: Blue Growth Cluster – Connecting Montenegro’s Blue Economy
excerpt: An introduction to Montenegro’s Blue Growth Cluster, connecting businesses and supporting technology transfer, skills development and cooperation across blue economy sectors.
body:
This June 2023 video introduces the Montenegrin Blue Growth Cluster, established in Kotor to strengthen the competitiveness of businesses in fisheries, aquaculture, tourism and maritime transport.

The cluster promotes technology transfer, innovative education and skills development, helping members respond to market needs and contribute to a sustainable blue economy.

Cooperation with other Adriatic clusters offers opportunities to exchange knowledge, develop partnerships and connect Montenegro’s blue economy with regional and international markets.
